sources.snippet: This model card documents Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B, the mid-size mixture-of-experts member of the Ornith-1.5 family. sources.snippet: What is Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B? Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B is a sparse mixture-of-experts model from Ornith with 36B total parameters and about 3B active per token, released on August 18, 2026 under MIT.

sources.title: Ornith 1.5 35B | Model APIs - runinfra.ai
sources.snippet: Ornith 1.5 35B is an LLM listed in RunInfra Model APIs. RunInfra serves it as ornith-ai/Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B at $0.10 per 1M input tokens and $0.40 per 1M output tokens. Its context window is 262,144 tokens. The API provides OpenAI-compatible chat completions.
